generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have satisfactorily completed in the last five years at least one work of Construction of Stations/Transmission Lines/ Erection of Towers/Maintenance or rectification work of EHV Transmission lines/ One Terminal Bay of 66KV class or above voltage class on Total Turn Key, Partial Turnkey basis for the last five financial years in KPTCL/PGCIL/ NHPC/NTPC/ any Govt., or public sector under takings & produce experience and performance certificate duly signed by competent authorities not below the rank of the Executive Engineer Electrical, which shall be in satisfactory service for a period of One year prior to date of submission of the Bid. Scanned copy of the supporting original Documents shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- self declaration for risk & cost

technicalCriterionList.description: Bidder shall have adequate knowledge of Sub-stations and Transmission lines, design, procedure including quality control and shall have infrastructure and erection facilities and capacity to execute the works

A Certificate is required to be uploaded by Bidder separately regarding restrictions on procurement from a Bidder of a country which shares a land border with India in the format as specified in the clause No.1.5 of Annexure XVIII of the tender documents

Certificate is to be uploaded by the Bidder agreeing to source the equipment/material for the work from the approved vendors who meet the eligibility clauses regarding restrictions on procurement from a country which shares a land border with India as specified in Annexure XVIII of the tender documents
The bidder should provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the preceding five years

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- self declaration for no litigation

technicalCriterionList.description: An undertaking to source the supply of equipment/ material from KPTCL approved vendors only as per the QR for vendor registration
